spanish: Y alma, cuando acerque ofrenda de minjá a Jehová, sólet será su ofrenda, y derramará sobre ella aceite, y dará sobre ella incienso.

findings.issue: Common noun מִנְחָה is left as the untranslated lemma minjá; a non-name must be Spanish.
Common noun סֹלֶת is left as the untranslated lemma sólet; a non-name must be Spanish.
כִּי is only a conjunction and stays open among if, when, that, and because; cuando selects the temporal sense.

notes: Jehová, the singulars, both sobre ella, and the 3ms pour-then-give sequence match the tokens.
